results.name: The Amazing Spider-Man
results.dimensions: standard Silver Age U.S. (#1-141); standard Modern Age U.S. (#142-441)
results.notes: Issue #-1 was published between #424 and #425. Between #406 and #407 (November-December 1995) this title went on a hiatus and was replaced with "The Amazing Scarlet Spider" #1 and #2 (www.comics.org/series/10341/). This was the case for all four Spider-Titles during these two months. The 441 issues in this series (#1-441) are considered issues #1-441 in "The Amazing Spider-Man" Legacy [LGY] numbering. Variants named "Whitman" are a distribution variant arranged in plastic bags known as pre-packs, 3 packs or multipacks and distributed by Western Publishing Company, Inc. Indicia in the "Whitman" named variants has been found to be the same as the base indicia.
